name: Automatically rotate hero slides
description: Home hero only. Turn off to keep the first enabled slide until a visitor chooses another.

name: Hero slide duration (milliseconds)
description: Home hero only. 2000 = 2 seconds, 5000 = 5 seconds. Defaults to 2000.

name: Image or 3D display
description: Shop/collection hero: 3d uses the selected product photograph as a 3D study; image displays its photograph. Uploaded section images take priority. Ingredient sections also accept image.
